items.title: Booby Trapping LLMs - AI Frenzy in Cybercrime
items.summary: Hosts: Steve Gibson and Leo Laporte Security Now episode 1100 More Info: https://twit.tv/shows/security-now/episodes/1100 Sponsors: • http://threatlocker.com/twit • http://hoxhunt.com/securitynow • http://originhq.com/securitynow • http://trustedtech.team/twit Think your open-source AI model is safe? This episode uncovers how LLMs can be secretly booby-trapped with undetectable backdoors, raising the stakes for anyone deploying AI in serious environments. • Anthropic cuts live Internet access during testing. • Will LLM technology turn out to be an uncontrollable dead end? • What alternative AI technologies are underway? • Anthropic offers free AI vulnerability scanning for open source. • South Korean banks hit by Claude-driven cyberattacks. • Japan declares a state of cyber-emergency due to attacks. • For one listener, agentic coding has taken the joy out of coding. • A listener is having way too much fun with AI and Halloween. • Some listeners believe I'm downplaying the dangers of AI. • We carefully examine the consequences of maliciously trained AI Show Notes - https://www.grc.com/sn/SN-1100-Notes.pdf Products we recommend: https://www.amazon.com/shop/twitnetcastnetwork TWiT may earn commissions on certain products. Think your open-source AI model is safe? This episode uncovers how LLMs can be secretly booby-trapped with undetectable backdoors, raising the stakes for anyone deploying AI in serious environments.
• Anthropic cuts live Internet access during testing.
• Will LLM technology turn out to be an uncontrollable dead end?
• What alternative AI technologies are underway?
• Anthropic offers free AI vulnerability scanning for open source.
• South Korean banks hit by Claude-driven cyberattacks.
• Japan declares a state of cyber-emergency due to attacks.
• For one listener, agentic coding has taken the joy out of coding.
• A listener is having way too much fun with AI and Halloween.
• Some listeners believe I'm downplaying the dangers of AI.
• We carefully examine the consequences of maliciously trained AI
